narratives.name: Build and Run Applications Practice Intent
narratives.description: The end-to-end narrative of how the Build and Run Applications play progresses from customer discovery through deal expansion.

narrativeContexts.context: Enterprise customers face mounting legacy application costs, fragmented development toolchains, and slow release cycles that constrain business agility. The Build and Run Applications play equips sellers to identify these pain points through a structured Customer Lens covering application portfolio assessment, developer productivity barriers, and CI/CD maturity gaps.

Validation centers on mapping the customer's application landscape to a three-TDP solution stack -- App Platform for developer experience and platform engineering, AI Platform for intelligent application capabilities, and Automation for CI/CD and operational efficiency. Real-world evidence from Vodafone, Lloyds Banking Group, and stc Group substantiates the value proposition.

The value proposition is structured around three drivers: Cost (reduced legacy maintenance and technical debt), Complexity (simplified CI/CD with trusted software supply chain), and Choice (portable applications across any environment). Sellers construct quantified business cases connecting release velocity, developer productivity, and platform flexibility to measurable business outcomes.

Deal advancement leverages the multi-TDP app delivery stack to demonstrate comprehensive coverage of the customer's application modernization journey -- from legacy migration through cloud-native development to operational automation. Services and partner solutions align to the customer's modernization timeline.

Closing integrates technical validation results, quantified business impact, and customer reference evidence into a cohesive proposal that addresses both technical and business decision-maker requirements.

Post-sale engagement tracks application modernization outcomes against pre-sale commitments, using demonstrated results to expand platform adoption across additional application portfolios, business units, and deployment environments.

narratives.name: Build and Run Applications Play Context and Rationale
narratives.description: Why the Build and Run Applications Play alpha matters within the sales play framework.

narrativeContexts.context: Enterprise customers face a growing tension between legacy application portfolios consuming maintenance budgets and the demand for faster delivery of new cloud-native applications. Fragmented development toolchains, inconsistent CI/CD practices, and security governance gaps across distributed application estates create complexity that constrains developer productivity and business agility.

The Build and Run Applications play must enable sellers to apply a structured Customer Lens that assesses the customer's application portfolio, identifies developer productivity barriers, and maps desired outcomes to a three-TDP app delivery solution stack spanning App Platform, AI Platform, and Automation.

Sellers apply the Customer Lens to assess the customer's app landscape, engage CIO, VP Applications, and CTO/Platform Engineering personas with tailored discovery, align the three-TDP stack to the customer's technology decisions, and articulate value through Cost, Complexity, and Choice drivers with quantified customer reference evidence.

Structured play execution produces qualified pipeline attributed to application modernization themes, with customer engagements progressing through technical validation of the app delivery platform stack to commercial proposals backed by evidence from customers like Vodafone, Lloyds Banking Group, and stc Group.

patterns.name: Build and Run Applications Sales Play Lifecycle
patterns.description: End-to-end lifecycle coordinating how the Build and Run Applications play progresses from customer lens application through deal advancement.

patternViews.name: Prerequisites
patternViews.description: Initial conditions before Build and Run play execution begins.

narrativeContexts.context: Before engaging customers on application modernization, sellers must complete Build and Run play awareness training covering the Customer Lens, three target personas, value drivers, and the three-TDP app delivery stack (App Platform, AI Platform, Automation).

patternViews.name: Discovery
patternViews.description: Apply app modernization Customer Lens and engage decision-maker personas.
activities: Apply Build and Run Customer Lens

narrativeContexts.context: The seller applies the Build and Run Customer Lens to assess the customer's application landscape, identifying legacy proportion, cloud-native adoption level, and developer productivity barriers. Persona-specific engagement with CIO, VP Applications, and CTO/Platform Engineering validates pain points and builds multi-stakeholder engagement.

patternViews.name: Technology Alignment
patternViews.description: Map customer's app technology decisions to TDPs and construct app delivery solution narrative.

narrativeContexts.context: The customer's technology decisions are mapped to App Platform, AI Platform, and Automation TDPs. A multi-TDP app delivery solution narrative connects modernization (legacy migration), development (DevX and platform engineering), and operations (CI/CD automation) into a coherent platform stack.

patternViews.name: Value and Validation
patternViews.description: Articulate app modernization value through the three-driver framework and validate technology fit.

narrativeContexts.context: The value proposition is structured through Cost (reduced legacy maintenance, technical debt elimination), Complexity (simplified CI/CD, trusted software supply chain), and Choice (portable applications, open hybrid cloud). Customer evidence from Vodafone, Lloyds Banking Group, and stc Group substantiates each value driver with quantified outcomes.

patternViews.name: Deal Advancement
patternViews.description: Convert validated app modernization value into deal commitment and pipeline attribution.
activities: Measure Build and Run Play Performance

narrativeContexts.context: Validated app modernization value is converted into commercial commitment through agreed next steps (technical workshop, platform demo, migration assessment, or proof of value). Competitive positioning is defended against container platform and cloud-native alternatives. Services and partner solutions align to the customer's modernization timeline.

The deal is registered with pipeline attributed to the Build and Run Applications play. Content engagement tracking, multi-stakeholder buy-in, and competitive differentiation provide the evidence base for the commercial decision.

Post-sale engagement tracks app modernization outcomes against pre-sale commitments. Performance measurement feeds back into play optimization, with Build and Run-specific TDP-tactic combination analysis identifying the most effective app delivery selling motions.
